Slop Timesheets · free, in your browser

A free Toggl alternative, in your browser

If you want a time tracker without an online account, Slop Timesheets runs in your browser and keeps every entry on this device, next to your invoices.

Try Slop Timesheets

How to do it

  1. Start the timer, or log time afterwards.
  2. Tag each entry with a customer, a project and an hourly rate.
  3. See totals by week or month and download CSV.
  4. Bill open hours on a draft invoice in Slop Invoices.

What it has: a timer that survives a reload, typed durations, customers and projects, billable and internal time, week and month totals, CSV, and billing straight to an invoice. What it does not have: a team, apps for the desktop, or sync between devices.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Timesheets runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slop Timesheets made by Toggl?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with Toggl. Toggl is a trademark of its owner, and the name is used here only to describe what people search for.

Can I use it on two computers?

The data is kept in one browser. Move it with a full backup file from Slop Admin; there is no live sync.

Is my time data uploaded?

No. Every entry is kept in this browser on this device.
